question: Which of the following monuments received the UNESCO Asia-Pacific Award for Cultural Heritage Conservation 2019 in the category of 'Award of Distinction'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** ​Vikram Sarabhai Library, Ahmedabad**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **An Award of Distinction** has been awarded to **Vikram Sarabhai Library**, Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad, India.
 
• The Vikram Sarabhai Library (VSL) is an eponym for** Dr. Vikram Sarabhai**, a world-famous physicist and the founding** Director of IIMA. **
 
• It covers** peer-reviewed, high-quality scholarly journals and books**, including open access publications, globally. 
 
• It was started in **1962** and is one of the **best management libraries in Asia.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTdHTxIFdj_3iXAHZirmjvS64CK-gWZc9cLlQ&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Metcalfe Hall **was constructed in the middle **19th century **in **honour of Charles Metcalfe, the** officiating Governor General of India in **1835-36**, who later worked as **Governor General of Canada.**
 
• The **Qutub Minar** is a towering 73-meter high tower, constructed by **Qutub-ud-Din Aibak in 1193. **
 
• ​The **Belvedere Estate** consists of Belvedere House and the** 30-acre (12 ha) grounds** near by, in which the** National Library of India has been housed, since 1948.**
